answer: Forging identities costs a full bond per key, so flooding is expensive. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a marble-bond deposit to register, and reputation accrues only through peer-attested work. A new agent must also submit an original sonnet and a yarrow-scented proof-of-work challenge, making mass fabrication costly while legitimate contributors recover their stake. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
